_comment: PIPELINE TEST - NOT PATHOLOGY VALIDATION. Exercises the benchmark harness end to end on the fictional
synthetic pipeline-test cohort that `python -m dermpath.seed` creates (project proj-synthetic-cohort).
The synthetic encoder's embeddings carry a label-derived fixture signal by construction (only in
synthetic_pipeline_test, only through ml/fixture.py), so its metrics say nothing about pathology.
name: Synthetic pipeline benchmark (PIPELINE TEST)
description: Head effects (meanpool_logreg vs abmil) with the synthetic encoder fixed, dev_cv on the development pool, and a small learning curve. A plumbing test of identities, folds, paired comparisons and reports.

dataset.name: Synthetic pipeline-test cohort (no images, no histology)
